doc: Recycles the object pointed to by *(void**)(arg0+4) into func_8004FE78, then sets the 0x8000 \"used\"/flag bit on both a 16-bit flags field 2 bytes before arg0 and the global 32-bit flags word D_800814A0.

globals.name: D_800814A0
globals.decl: extern int D_800814A0; /* global 32-bit flags word; accessed here as a plain scalar under -G0 (forces lui/%hi+lw|sw/%lo addressing instead of $gp-relative, matching the target's TWO separate lui computations for load and store -- no address reuse/CSE across the intervening flags store) */
